messages:
Lina K: Quick sync — thinking about pushing fairness/shaping into the bridge-proxy vs keeping it in admission service. tradeoffs?
Samir: +1 to discuss. main worry is double-counting tokens and losing kv-cache locality.
Ana: Bridge benefits: locality of tenant streams, immediate backpressure before reach ingress. Cons: hard to maintain global fairness across distributed proxies.
mitch: also adds complexity to cert/config rollout. If proxy keeps per-tenant counters, we need consistent hashing or central shard.
Samir: sketch of hybrid: proxy enforces soft-per-conn windows (fast path) + admission has final levers. proxies emit go/no-go tokens into controller.
Lina K: concretely: proxy keeps token-bucket with rate=rate_hint from controller. If over threshold, proxy returns 429 with Retry-After or open circuit.
deploy-bot: new proxy image pushed to staging: r-proxy:v2026-03-10-bridgefair. rolling deploy started :rocket:
Ana: questions: what about fairness metrics? want per-tenant / per-route weighting + age-based decay. Also visibility for SLOs.
mitch: implementation note:
```
proxy config:
  fairness_mode: hybrid
  soft_window_ms: 200
  global_weight_key: tenant_id
```
Need migration tests.
Samir: failure modes: split-brain counters -> transient unfairness. mitigation: controller checkpoints every 5s + grpc stream to proxies.
Lina K: rollout plan proposal:
1) add metrics + dry-run proxies
2) enable soft-window enforcement in <10% traffic
3) promote to 50% with controller fallback
4) full enforcement and remove admission duplicates
Any objections?
Ana: +1. Add eval harness to run synthetic abuse patterns (short bursts, many small tenants) and confirm no regressions.
mitch: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with interface contracts (grpc endpoints, config schema) and a small compatibility shim.
Samir: tagging @oncall for visibility when we start staged rollouts.
thread_summary: Discuss whether to enforce fairness in bridge-proxy vs admission service; propose hybrid (proxy soft-windows + controller final decisions), config sketch, failure modes, and rollout plan with dry-run, metrics, and eval harness.
